author: Fouled
body:
Yo,

NOTE: Sorry if this sounds rude, it's not supposed to xP
Throughout of the Map Development discussions, we realized that most of the maps releases on Avicus don't really show too much effort put into them (somewhat low quality). High quality maps, with good game-play, aesthetics, etc take quite a long time to make (which is a good thing). If you look at maps from other networks, they have more effort put into their maps, which leads to high quality game-play and aesthetics. The map releases could use some... different formations. Try actually experimenting with YAML and before you make what you think will look good, see it in the eyes of players. Actually look from above the routes, width and difficulty. Ask yourself questions, and if any of them are failing factors, work on it and start to improve. 

The point that we're trying to make is too spend more time on making maps, and put more thought and effort into them.
If you're new to making maps, practicing is the key! :)

Thanks and have a wonderful day! :D

replies.author: Hibiya
replies.body:
Try actually experimenting with YAML...

What is there truly to experiment with this extremely limited coding language? Projectiles? I understand Kylocode is starting to work on 'Icarus' (or Atlas or whatever) and all (which I assume will use XML), but the limitations of what you have to code maps with also hurts the map making process. Enoki's YAML purposefully had to break some things YAML uses in order to get what we wanted.

replies.author: Afr0
replies.body:
It would be nice to use XML, as I'm already comfortable with it.  I'd love to develop maps for Avicus, but I don't have the motivation for it.  Certain maps which are plain, unappealing, and unoriginal get "Great job!"s and "This should be in the rots!" which makes it seem like I wouldn't have to try very hard to get a map in.  That said, I'm not trying to ridicule those who have gotten their maps in, I'm just saying I think the standard for maps here should be raised a bit.

Take my words lightly, as I don't play here very often, but just my opinion on the matter.
